projects.notes: 25-acre prime parcel acquired for Rs 938.75 crore (deal completed 10-Dec-2025); ~5 million sqft developable; estimated GDV/revenue potential over Rs 5,000 crore. Strong early-entrant signal. TREAT PRICING AS INDICATIVE ONLY. The land deal is well documented: Prestige acquired 66.93% of Bharatnagar Buildcon LLP (Prestige Falcon Realty 63.12% + Prestige Projects 3.81%) for Rs 938.75 crore on 10 Dec 2025, giving ~25 acres in Medavakkam, ~5 msf developable, GDV Rs 5,000 crore+. The pricing above comes from an unofficial channel-partner site marketing 'Prestige Falcon City Chennai' on Medavakkam-Sholinganallur Road — Rs 10,800/sqft, 1,001-2,735 sqft, Rs 1.30-3.54 Cr, 2,170 units in 22 towers, official launch and RERA both said to be due 15 Dec 2026. I could NOT confirm that Falcon City is the same Bharatnagar Buildcon parcel (that site says 23 acres vs the 25 acres reported for the acquisition), and Prestige has published nothing official — another aggregator lists 'Prestige Medavakkam' 25 acres with price strictly 'on request' and Dec-2028 possession. Medavakkam market rate is currently Rs 8,500-12,500/sqft, so the quoted figure is at least plausible.

TWO DISCREPANCIES - treat with care. (1) Every public source places 'Rhythm By DAC' at Shantha Nagar/Sathasiva Nagar, MADAMBAKKAM, not Adambakkam; Madambakkam falls in TNRERA zone 35 (matching TNRERA/35/BLG/0237/2026) whereas Adambakkam would be zone 29, so the tracker's locality is very likely a transcription error. projects.locality_raw: Gerugambakkam (between Porur, Pallavaram and Guindy), Chennai
projects.ticket_note: Positioned at roughly half the plot rates of Porur/Manapakkam (exact rate not published in sources)
projects.notes: VGN's 261st project; affordable-luxury plotted development; 100 bookings and 2,000+ enquiries within launch weekend; upside from upcoming metro station, airport and IT-hub proximity (marketed '4X growth potential'). RERA TNRERA/1/LO/1078/2026 matches exactly - promoter VGN Builders Pvt Ltd, VGN MERIDIAN HEIGHTS PHASE-I, Gerugambakkam village, KUNDRATHUR taluk, Kancheepuram; 53,337 sq.m (13.18 acres), 342 units, project cost Rs 211 Cr, CMDA permission 22-Dec-2025, registered 18-Mar-2026, registry shows completed and JLL shows Phase 1 'Ready to Move' with Apr-2026 possession. Locality correction: this is Gerugambakkam/Porur (west-southwest Chennai), NOT Pallavaram - VGN's Pallavaram plotted scheme is a separate project, Southern Garden. Launched March 2026 as VGN's 261st project. Rs 7,000/sqft is derived and cross-consistent: JLL's two quoted pairs (850 sqft at Rs 59.5 L and 1300 sqft at Rs 91 L) both compute to exactly Rs 7,000/sqft; the developer's own site advertises a teaser 'from Rs 55 lakh'. Marketing pitch is 50+ amenities including an 11,000 sqft 'Club De Meridian', 38,000 sqft of parks across three parks, amphitheatre, pickleball and yoga courts, a 50-ft clock tower, underground electricals, IRC-standard roads and storm-water recharge trenches; elevated terrain, 6.2 km from the metro and airport, priced at roughly half Manapakkam rates. Locality corrected from Pallavaram to Gerugambakkam on research review.
projects.score_rationale: Scores on early entry stage, rising micro-market, priced below the locality band.
projects.density_note: large plotted township - 342 units (277 regular + 64 EWS + 1 commercial site) on 13.18 acres
